The available endpoints expose Hermes health, runtime state, profiles, host statistics, and sessions. They do not expose Tailscale peer names, IPs, WireGuard keys, transport latency, traffic, or ACLs, so this page does not invent them. Use the Tailscale admin console for physical mesh management.
